# World Universities Database

> Global universities and higher education institutions database. 10,200+ universities across 200+ countries with domains and websites.

This repository contains a database of world universities database covering 1 datasets with 10,239 records.

## Available Formats

- SQLite database (.db) — ready to query
- SQL dump (.sql) — import into MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, etc.
- Excel, CSV, PDF — available at https://listbase.org

## Data Structure

Table: `universities`
- `name` (TEXT NOT NULL)
- `country` (TEXT NOT NULL)
- `alpha_two_code` (TEXT)
- `state_province` (TEXT)
- `domains` (TEXT)
- `web_pages` (TEXT)

## Download

- GitHub Releases: https://github.com/listbase-org/world-universities-databases/releases
- Excel/CSV/PDF: https://listbase.org/en/education/
